pictures.name: CRT1-Bookshop-Door
pictures.prompt: A small bookseller’s shop in ancient Athens, shelves of scrolls. Zeno of Citium, a lean man of about thirty with a long neck, dark curly hair and a short dark beard, his face browned by the sea, in a plain tunic, looks up from an open scroll, asking the old white-bearded bookseller a question. Through the bright doorway behind them, out in the sunlit street, walks Crates the Cynic, a hunched, cheerful man in his fifties with a wild grey beard, in a ragged patched cloak, carrying a wooden staff and a leather bag. Warm gold light, deep blue shadows inside. Contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, slow and still mood. One tall 9:16 picture, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: CRT4-Lentil-Pot
pictures.prompt: A crowded street of potters’ workshops in ancient Athens. Zeno of Citium, a lean man of about thirty with a long neck, dark curly hair and a short dark beard, his face browned by the sea, embarrassed, red in the face, carries a round clay pot of lentil soup and tries to hide it under his cloak while people stare. Behind him, Crates the Cynic, a hunched, cheerful man in his fifties with a wild grey beard, in a ragged patched cloak, carrying a wooden staff and a leather bag, watches with a mischievous grin, staff in hand. Bright light, busy and comic. Contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, slow and still mood. pictures.name: CRT5-The-Crack
pictures.prompt: A crowded ancient Athenian street. A round clay pot has just cracked, lentil soup splashing down the legs of Zeno of Citium, a lean man of about thirty with a long neck, dark curly hair and a short dark beard, his face browned by the sea, who is running away, mortified. Behind him Crates the Cynic, a hunched, cheerful man in his fifties with a wild grey beard, in a ragged patched cloak, carrying a wooden staff and a leather bag, laughs warmly and calls after him, staff raised, while passersby gape. Comic, bright, gentle, no one hurt. Contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, slow and still mood.
